import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    best = 0
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        prev = None
        ok = True
        cnt = 0
        for i in range(n):
            if (mask >> i) & 1:
                if prev is not None and a[i] < prev:
                    ok = False
                    break
                prev = a[i]
                cnt += 1
        if ok and cnt > best:
            best = cnt
    print(n - best)


main()
